mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.5% over 3 months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in retail sales (RSAFS > 600,000) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a non-linear demand-monetary synergy that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low rates
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS > 600000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 140,000 thousand persons signals labor market strength that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100) create a non-linear demand-supply contraction that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST < 1500 and INDPRO < 100) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 2%), weak housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low GDP growth with weak housing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 2% and HOUST < 1500.
